name: Chasten Buttigieg

race_2028.basis: His husband, who served as a spokesperson and adviser on the 2020 campaign.

source.title: File:Chasten Buttigieg at Books in Bloom 2023 (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

summary: Chasten Buttigieg is a former teacher and the author of the bestselling memoir I Have Something to Tell You. He took leave to serve as a spokesperson and adviser on his husband Pete Buttigieg's 2020 campaign, and later joined the Democratic communications firm KNP Communications.
